resourceAssumptions.observed: No nvidia-smi/GPU;3 vCPUs,9.7GiB RAM; parent reports142MiB free disk before safe cache cleanup
resourceAssumptions.FLOPModel: 6*N*processedTokens dense training approximation; excludes quadratic attention, activation recomputation, padding, output/dataloader/save/evaluation overhead; not a measured runtime
resourceAssumptions.tokenBandMeaning: 20N and50N are illustrative planning bands, NOT an optimum, minimum sufficiency or language-success guarantee
resourceAssumptions.GPUHoursMeaning: 5/20 TFLOP/s are effective throughput scenarios, not GPU peak rates or claims about an available GPU. End-to-end measured tokens/s required before authorization; small models may be launch or input bound. Allow2–4x or more overhead until measured.
resourceAssumptions.optimizerMemory: FP32 param4+grad4+Adam first/second8=16 bytes/param excluding activations/runtime; model+Adam file roughly12 bytes/param if no duplicate beststate; autocast with FP32 model changes activation dtype, not this static16N state.
resourceAssumptions.VRAMMeaning: Trial device tiers are estimates for batch4–8,context512,efficient attention,optional activation checkpointing. No CUDA profiling was done; reduce microbatch and use accumulation, require peak-memory measurement/headroom. context1024 adds attention and activation cost, not only parameter count.
resourceAssumptions.disk: 12m fullstate~135MiB,28m~324MiB,61m~701MiB before archives/Git duplication;142MiB free cannot safely hold even the smallest run with restart/archive. Need>=1GiB spare for tiny/current-model pilot,>=4–8GiB for scale-state experiments, more for corpus/versioned caches.

architectureStrategy.stage0: Make explicit truthful conversation boundaries and deterministic causal training operational before claiming larger model improvement. Existing reserved user3/assistant4/turn5/EOS2 allow a no-external-tokenizer pilot. EOT/turn and conversation-EOS meanings must be frozen and supervised, not inferred from occasional standalone newline pieces.
architectureStrategy.roleCaution: Human participantA/B are not a genuine helpful assistant. Do not relabel their every utterance as ideal assistant behavior without task-quality review.
architectureStrategy.controlledScale: All new candidates share architecture family/context512/own tokenizer/data serialization/objective/token dose/evaluation; random initialization and fresh Adam avoid inheritance/new-coordinate-age confounds. Existing R46 remains a separate reference. A changed new-series package cannot identify capacity alone against R46.
architectureStrategy.laterAlternatives: RoPE,RMSNorm,SwiGLU,depth/context1024 are viable own implementations, not imported weights, but separate ablations rather than a simultaneous recipe interpreted as capacity-only.

tokenizerStrategy.initialControl: Keep existing own5455 BPE for a first bounded protocol/gradient/runtime pilot and controlled scale counts. No external vocabulary.
tokenizerStrategy.candidate: Own8k/16k BPE learned only from admitted TRAIN, preserve bytes/Unicode boundaries and reserved role/end IDs, report held-development roundtrip/fallback/length efficiency and bits-per-byte.
tokenizerStrategy.confounds: Changing V changes embedding capacity and token budget/sequence length; NLL per token across vocabularies is not comparable. Freeze a new tokenizer before training a new scale family and count actual parameters.
tokenizerStrategy.contextMeaning: Observed human efficiency1.273characters/token means context256~326chars,512~652chars on average; not a guaranteed turn capacity. Measure complete-history coverage and antecedent retention.

stagedLearning.training: Diverse human modern prose plus authentic whole conversations, causal CE and truthful end markers; whole response/body and endings receive positive training, no synthetic answers
stagedLearning.advance: Stable full raw continuations across held document/family topics, meaningful complete sentences, low harmful loops, no memorized-probe-only success

stagedLearning.training: Source-authenticated reply supervision with complete prior turns and balanced content-rich/short replies; retain foundation distribution through fixed replay/mixing, not64-pair-only concentration
stagedLearning.advance: Blind whole-response relevance/content and naturalness improve on family-held unseen diagnostic development, termination and retained prose performance do not regress

stagedLearning.training: Complete2–8turn histories, role/turn identity, reference and topic continuation/switch; expand context only when history-coverage diagnosis warrants it
stagedLearning.advance: Context minimal-pair appropriate content differentiation plus closed-loop multi-turn consistency; not merely changed wording

stagedLearning.training: Only after reliable daily Japanese; add provenance-aware knowledge and separately evaluated reasoning data
stagedLearning.advance: Independent held knowledge/generalization evidence; not this task

firstExecutableWork.recommended: Fresh new-series protocol/data/gradient/restart smoke, bounded CPU training only if measured runtime and disk permit; a meaningful larger-model training claim requires new licensed diverse text and actual accelerator access. Parent may instead choose a current-scale protocol pilot to validate the next series pipeline.
firstExecutableWork.pilotScale: Start current-scale or about12m,context128–256,microbatch1–2; profile a zero-update/very-few-update workload first, fit walltime/update/token budget before full pilot. Fixed held development and raw greedy generation before/after.
firstExecutableWork.notSuccess: Passing pipeline tests or learning a small training batch is an engineering readiness result, not natural language capability.
firstExecutableWork.scaleComparisonAfter: Same serialization/data/tokenizer and complete-epoch exposure, current-scale vs12m from scratch with equal processed-token budget,predeclared optimizer/LR,terminal not retrospective selected. Additional seed(s) needed before capacity claim.
firstExecutableWork.stop: No large CPU pretraining or cloud GPU purchase/provisioning merely because a theoretical FLOP estimate is small. Report hardware/data gap; no public replacement or merge.

priorityJudgment.main: Data distribution and training signal/retention are more directly implicated by current evidence than an inability to memorize at4.66m. This is a priority judgment, not proof of adequate broad-language capacity.
priorityJudgment.whyScaleRemainsCandidate: 4.66m capacity may limit compositional representations and generalization even while memorizing64; prior FFN expansion was not a decisive general capacity test. Controlled12m→28m→61m family is rational once data/compute validation makes it informative.
priorityJudgment.noMechanicalLossRoundLoop: Do not treat finishing retention/EOS comparisons as the goal. Continue only experiments that test a language-ability bottleneck and can change the roadmap.

confirmedParentPilot.status: Parent design received after independent analysis; not executed by this reviewer
confirmedParentPilot.newFamily: Fresh ownTokenizer fitted solely on newly speaker-split TRAIN; own glyph +512word merges; V must be measured after fitting
confirmedParentPilot.oneArmFactor: Width and mathematically derived FFN/embedding dimensions only within the new family; heads/layers/context/tokenizer/data/protocol/objective/seed/optimizer policy fixed
confirmedParentPilot.tokenProtocol: role3/4=humanA/B,EOS2=utterance end,document BOS at independent sample start; turn5 unused; all genuine causal body+role+EOS targets trained
confirmedParentPilot.initialization: Own random initialization +fresh Adam, not inherited R46 state; same seed does not imply equal arrays for differently shaped models
confirmedParentPilot.proposedBudget: 512unique+2resume replay perarm=1028actual total maximum; totalCPU training wall ceiling30minutes,2threads; Go only if profile including save/evaluation overhead fits
confirmedParentPilot.scope: New protocol/tokenizer/split/optimizer/model package versus R46 is multi-factor descriptive; width effect is only between the two new models
confirmedParentPilot.importantCorrectionsToInitialOptions: OldBPE reuse is unsuitable for true newly-held speaker evaluation because the old tokenizer saw the original TRAIN speakers. Fresh TRAIN-only tokenizer is chosen by parent. Parent EOS protocol uses2 as every-turn end rather than the optional separate-turn5 proposal; this must be consistent in training/inference/evaluation.

comparisonExposureCaution: The new speaker-held source documents were original TRAIN of R46. They are unseen to fresh new-family models/tokenizer but seen to R46 weights/tokenizer. R46-versus-new comparison on these inputs is not equal unseen-generalization evidence.
attentionBoundaryCaution: A BOS token does not reset attention by itself. Use one document per sample/window or explicit cross-document causal mask; validate no context leaks across packed documents. Separate body NLL from easy role/end token NLL.
